stem.text: Some antibiotics kill prokaryotes by binding to RNA polymerase.
What effect will this have on protein synthesis?

A.text: Codons on mRNA will be unable to hydrogen bond to complementary anticodons on tRNA.

B.text: Condensation reactions joining RNA nucleotides will not take place to form mRNA.

C.text: DNA will not unwind and unzip to allow for base pairing with RNA nucleotides.

D.text: Free RNA nucleotides will not base pair to exposed bases on the DNA template strand.
